svg.text: yaw: the ring turns against the Bolt's turn
locator step: the parallax of the believed distance
turns the ring, and shortens the distance by the step along the bearing
Proposed 2026-11-08: 36 ring neurons, 10 distance neurons, nothing leaks. Nose is up, angles run clockwise. Signals flow inward: receivers, ring, motor.
Blue excites, red inhibits, width is the measured weight: every frame by its level, every silent slot, every corner read.
Dashed ochre: not edges but computed each step from the motion stream, as the ring's turn is today.
The ring holds direction, the column distance; a frame stays good after a move because the belief moves with the Bolt.
Bench: recordings 69 % on target, 30° mean error; the marked run of 11-08 42 % (ring of 11-07: 41 %, 60°; 3 %).
